text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Phew~! Ran a whole bunch today, too~!
Ah... Sis, Sis!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Huh? Eeeeeh!? Why the heck are you here!?

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
“...... I came to watch! I mean... just 
because I was curious!”

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Come on, why not?! You could at least let 
me see a little bit!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Y-You wanna look? Hmm... Is there really 
anything on my side you'd want to see?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, whoa! Ah! Alright, alright, I get 
it, hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The countryside gets boring sometimes, 
right~? I'll show ya the city! In all its 
glory!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: ......Huh? What?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—How's that! Pretty fancy carrot shake, 
huh? They even did a special feature on TV 
about it! Apparently it's super popular in 
the city~!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
No, it's delicious, but... still, still! 
...That's not what I meant~...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, how about a VR baseball game!? 
It's fresh and feels totally big city, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"……Is this broken? All I'm hitting are 
home runs! The balls are bouncing around 
way too much! ……I mean, I'm not interested 
in the first place!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh. I-I see... Sorry about that...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Al... alright! I'm heading out today too, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a training day with Katsuragi Ace. 
While watching over her—I noticed a girl 
I'd never seen before hiding at the edge 
of the track!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Sis, you're so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When beckoned over to a better vantage 
point, Katsuragi Ace's little sister 
dashed over, careful not to let her older 
sister spot her.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: "...Onee's Trainer. I came to observe..."

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, she sped up again...! Does Big Sis 
always push herself this hard?
choice_data_list: Some days are even harder, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Huh!? More than this!? Amazing...

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: I knew it... you're so cool, Sis...
choice_data_list:
You always give me the energy to take on 
new challenges!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: ! ...Me too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the day finally came for 
my little sister to return home. Katsuragi 
Ace and I decided to see her off together.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, well... you know! Sorry for putting 
on airs!! Turns out I really couldn't 
guide you around the big city after all!"

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
...No. It's fine. I got to see what I 
wanted to see, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Well, if that's fine with you, 
then alright...”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway, be careful on your way home! You 
know where to transfer, right? Got your 
ticket? Message me as soon as you get 
back!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez! I get it already!! See ya!!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Ah. ...Good luck with the race.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. Yeah! See ya!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving one last word of encouragement, 
Katsuragi Ace's younger sister headed off 
toward the station.
choice_data_list: I think she really enjoyed the trip!

You got some energy from your little 
sister, huh!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Did it look that way to you? I was 
actually showing you around the city like 
a local!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it... but hey, as long 
as they had fun, that's what matters!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Just a tiny mutter under my breath, 
though!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, that girl just can't be honest 
with herself!
